shiv.name: Shiv
shiv.en: Attack with your off-hand, dealing 1,692 Physical damage, dispelling all enrage effects and applying a concentrated form of your active Non-Lethal poison. Awards 1 combo point.
shiv.desc: 用副手攻击，造成 1,692 点物理伤害，驱散所有激怒效果，并施加你当前激活的非致命毒药的浓缩形态。获得 1 个连击点。

blind.name: Blind
blind.en: Blinds the target, causing it to wander disoriented for 18 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect. Limit 1.
blind.desc: 致盲目标，使其迷失方向游荡 18 秒。受到伤害可能打断效果。限制 1 个目标。

cloak-of-shadows.name: Cloak of Shadows
cloak-of-shadows.en: Provides a moment of magic immunity, instantly removing all harmful spell effects. The cloak lingers, causing you to resist harmful spells for 7 sec.
cloak-of-shadows.desc: 提供短暂的魔法免疫，立即移除所有有害法术效果。暗影斗篷持续生效，使你在 7 秒内抵抗有害法术。

toxic-stiletto.name: Toxic Stiletto
toxic-stiletto.en: Shiv's Energy cost is reduced by 20, its cooldown is reduced by 15 sec, and its range is increased by 3 yds.
toxic-stiletto.desc: 毒刃的能量消耗降低 20，冷却时间缩短 15 秒，范围增加 3 码。

gouge.name: Gouge
gouge.en: Gouges the eyes of an enemy target, incapacitating for 4 sec. Damage may interrupt the effect. Must be in front of your target. Awards 1 combo point.
gouge.desc: 刺入敌方目标的眼睛，使其昏迷 4 秒。受到伤害可能打断效果。必须位于目标正面。获得 1 个连击点。

thrill-seeking.name: Thrill Seeking
thrill-seeking.desc: 暗影步 额外获得 1 层充能。

shadowrunner.name: Shadowrunner
shadowrunner.en: While Stealth or Shadow Dance is active, you move 20% faster.
shadowrunner.desc: 处于潜行或 暗影之舞 激活状态时，移动速度提升 20%。

master-poisoner.name: Master Poisoner
master-poisoner.en: Increases the non-damaging effects of your weapon poisons by 20%.
master-poisoner.desc: 武器毒药的非伤害效果提升 20%。

elusiveness.name: Elusiveness
elusiveness.en: Evasion also reduces damage taken by 20%, and Feint also reduces non-area-of-effect damage taken by 20%.
elusiveness.desc: 闪避同时将受到的伤害降低 20%，佯攻同时将受到的非范围伤害降低 20%。

blackjack.name: Blackjack
blackjack.en: Enemies have 30% reduced damage and healing for 6 sec after Blind or Sap's effect on them ends.
blackjack.desc: 致盲或闷棍的效果在敌人身上结束后，该敌人造成的伤害和治疗效果降低 30%，持续 6 秒。

improved-wound-poison.name: Improved Wound Poison
improved-wound-poison.en: Wound Poison can now stack 2 additional times.
improved-wound-poison.desc: 致伤药膏 可额外叠加 2 层。

nimble-fingers.name: Nimble Fingers
nimble-fingers.en: Energy cost of Feint and Crimson Vial reduced by 10.
nimble-fingers.desc: 佯攻和 猩红之瓶 的能量消耗降低 10。

improved-sprint.name: Improved Sprint
improved-sprint.en: Reduces the cooldown of Sprint by 60 sec.
improved-sprint.desc: 疾跑的冷却时间缩短 60 秒。

superior-mixture.name: Superior Mixture
superior-mixture.en: Crippling Poison reduces movement speed by an additional 10%.
superior-mixture.desc: 减速药膏 的移动减速效果额外提升 10%。

evasion.name: Evasion
evasion.en: Increases your dodge chance by 100% for 10 sec.

iron-stomach.name: Iron Stomach
iron-stomach.en: Increases the healing you receive from Crimson Vial, healing potions, and healthstones by 25%.
iron-stomach.desc: 从 猩红之瓶、治疗药水和生命之石获得的治疗量提升 25%。

virulent-poisons.name: Virulent Poisons
virulent-poisons.en: Increases the damage of your weapon poisons by 10%.
virulent-poisons.desc: 武器毒药造成的伤害提升 10%。

stillshroud.name: Stillshroud
stillshroud.en: Shroud of Concealment has 50% reduced cooldown.
stillshroud.desc: 潜伏帷幕 的冷却时间缩短 50%。

graceful-guile.name: Graceful Guile
graceful-guile.desc: 佯攻额外获得 1 层充能。

featherfoot.name: Featherfoot
featherfoot.en: Sprint increases movement speed by an additional 30% and has 4 sec increased duration.
featherfoot.desc: 疾跑的移动速度额外提升 30%，持续时间延长 4 秒。

numbing-poison.name: Numbing Poison
numbing-poison.en: Coats your weapons with a Non-Lethal Poison that lasts for 1 hour. Each strike has a 40% chance of poisoning the enemy, clouding their mind and slowing their attack and casting speed by 18% for 10 sec.
numbing-poison.desc: 为武器涂抹一种非致命毒药，持续 1 小时。每次攻击命中有 40% 几率使敌人中毒，迷惑其心智，使其攻击速度和施法速度降低 18%，持续 10 秒。

deadly-precision.name: Deadly Precision
deadly-precision.en: Increases the critical strike chance of your attacks that generate combo points by 5%.
deadly-precision.desc: 产生连击点的攻击暴击率提升 5%。

sanguine-vial.name: Sanguine Vial
sanguine-vial.en: When you deal the killing blow to a target that yields experience or honor, the cooldown of Crimson Vial is reduced by 15 sec and your next use heals 5% of your health instantly.
sanguine-vial.desc: 当你对可获得经验值或荣誉的目标给予最后一击时，猩红之瓶 的冷却时间缩短 15 秒，且下次使用时立即恢复 5% 的生命值。

deep-cuts.name: Deep Cuts
deep-cuts.en: Your finishing moves deal 6% increased damage.
deep-cuts.desc: 终结技造成的伤害提升 6%。

unbreakable-stride.name: Unbreakable Stride
unbreakable-stride.en: Reduces the duration of movement slowing effects 30%.
unbreakable-stride.desc: 移动减速效果的持续时间缩短 30%。

danger-sense.name: Danger Sense
danger-sense.en: You have a 20% chance to partially evade any damage dealt to you, reducing the damage it deals by 20%.
danger-sense.desc: 你有 20% 的几率部分规避受到的任意伤害，使该次伤害降低 20%。

swift-slasher.name: Swift Slasher
swift-slasher.en: Slice and Dice grants additional attack speed equal to 100% of your Haste.
swift-slasher.desc: 切割 额外提供等同于你急速值 100% 的攻击速度加成。

improved-ambush.name: Improved Ambush
improved-ambush.desc: 暗影打击 造成的伤害提升 8%。

leeching-poison.name: Leeching Poison
leeching-poison.en: Adds a Leeching effect to your Lethal poisons, granting you 3.6% Leech.
leeching-poison.desc: 为你的致命毒素附加 Leeching 效果，为你提供 3.6% 吸血。

lethality.name: Lethality
lethality.en: Critical strike chance increased by 2%. Critical strike damage bonus of your attacks that generate combo points increased by 20%.
lethality.desc: 暴击率提高 2%。能产生连击点的攻击，其暴击伤害加成提高 20%。

recuperator.name: Recuperator
recuperator.en: Slice and Dice heals you for up to 1% of your maximum health per 3 sec.
recuperator.desc: 切割 每 3 秒为你恢复最多 1% 的最大生命值。

soothing-darkness.name: Soothing Darkness
soothing-darkness.en: You are healed for 32% of your maximum health over 6 sec after activating Vanish.
soothing-darkness.desc: 激活消失后，在 6 秒内恢复 32% 的最大生命值。

vigor.name: Vigor
vigor.en: Increases your maximum Energy by 100 and Energy regeneration by 10%.
vigor.desc: 最大能量上限提高 100，能量回复速率提高 10%。

supercharger.name: Supercharger
supercharger.en: Shadow Dance supercharges 4 combo points. Damaging finishing moves consume a supercharged combo point to function as if they spent 2 additional combo points.
supercharger.desc: 暗影之舞 会超充 4 个连击点。造成伤害的终结技消耗一个超充连击点时，效果视同额外花费了 2 个连击点。

subterfuge.name: Subterfuge
subterfuge.en: Abilities requiring Stealth can be used for 4 sec after Stealth breaks. Combat benefits requiring Stealth persist for an additional 4 sec after Stealth breaks.
subterfuge.desc: 潜行解除后 4 秒内，仍可使用需要潜行状态的技能。需要潜行状态的战斗增益在潜行解除后额外持续 4 秒。

thistle-tea.name: Thistle Tea
thistle-tea.en: Restore 100 Energy. When your Energy is reduced below 30, drink a Thistle Tea.
thistle-tea.desc: 恢复 100 能量。当你的能量降至 30 以下时，自动饮用 蓟叶茶。

cold-blooded-killer.name: Cold Blooded Killer
cold-blooded-killer.en: Critically striking with an attack that generates combo points increases the critical strike chance of your next finishing move by 10%.
cold-blooded-killer.desc: 能产生连击点的攻击触发暴击时，你的下一个终结技暴击率提高 10%。

forced-induction.name: Forced Induction
forced-induction.en: Increase the bonus granted when a damaging finishing move consumes a supercharged combo point by 1.
forced-induction.desc: 将造成伤害的终结技消耗超充连击点时所获得的加成额外提高 1。

deeper-stratagem.name: Deeper Stratagem
deeper-stratagem.en: Gain 1 additional max combo point. Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.
deeper-stratagem.desc: 最大连击点上限额外增加 1。消耗超过 5 个连击点的终结技效果提升，且你的终结技造成的伤害提高 5%。

without-a-trace.name: Without a Trace
without-a-trace.desc: 消失额外获得 1 层充能。

find-weakness.name: Find Weakness
find-weakness.en: Your Stealth abilities allow you to see the flaws in enemies' defenses, causing your attacks to ignore 30% armor for 10 sec.
find-weakness.desc: 你的潜行技能让你洞察敌人防御的破绽，使你的攻击在 10 秒内无视目标 30% 的护甲。

improved-backstab.name: Improved Backstab
improved-backstab.en: Gloomblade has 15% increased critical strike chance. While behind your target, Backstab critical strikes grant Find Weakness for 10 sec.
improved-backstab.desc: 幽暗之刃 的暴击率提高 15%。处于目标身后时，背刺 触发暴击可为你施加 洞悉弱点，持续 10 秒。

shadow-blades.name: Shadow Blades
shadow-blades.en: Draws upon surrounding shadows to empower your weapons, causing your attacks to deal 23% additional damage as Shadow and causing your combo point generating abilities to generate double combo points for 18 sec.
shadow-blades.desc: 汲取周围的暗影之力强化你的武器，使你的攻击额外造成 23% 暗影伤害，并使你产生连击点的技能在 18 秒内产生双倍连击点。

improved-shuriken-storm.name: Improved Shuriken Storm
improved-shuriken-storm.en: Shuriken Storm has 15% increased critical strike chance. Shuriken Storm critical strikes grant Find Weakness for 10 sec.
improved-shuriken-storm.desc: 袖剑风暴 的暴击率提高 15%。袖剑风暴 触发暴击可为你施加 洞悉弱点，持续 10 秒。

premeditation.name: Premeditation
premeditation.en: After entering Stealth, your next combo point generating ability generates full combo points.
premeditation.desc: 进入潜行后，你的下一个产生连击点的技能将产生最大数量的连击点。

quick-decisions.name: Quick Decisions
quick-decisions.en: Shadowstep's cooldown is reduced by 20%, and its maximum range is increased by 20%.
quick-decisions.desc: 暗影步 的冷却时间缩短 20%，最大范围增加 20%。

silent-storm.name: Silent Storm
silent-storm.en: Gaining Stealth, Vanish, or Shadow Dance causes your next Shuriken Storm to have 100% increased chance to critically strike.
silent-storm.desc: 进入潜行、消失或 暗影之舞 后，你的下一次 袖剑风暴 暴击率提高 100%。

shrouded-in-darkness.name: Shrouded in Darkness
shrouded-in-darkness.en: Shroud of Concealment increases the movement speed of allies by 100% and leaving its area no longer cancels the effect.
shrouded-in-darkness.desc: 潜伏帷幕 使范围内盟友的移动速度提高 100%，且离开区域后效果不再取消。

shot-in-the-dark.name: Shot in the Dark
shot-in-the-dark.en: After using Vanish or Shadow Dance, your next Cheap Shot is free and ignores its cooldown.
shot-in-the-dark.desc: 使用消失或 暗影之舞 后，你的下一次偷袭无需花费能量且无视冷却时间。

fade-to-nothing.name: Fade to Nothing
fade-to-nothing.en: Movement speed increased by 20% and damage taken reduced by 10% for 8 sec after gaining Stealth, Vanish, or Shadow Dance.
fade-to-nothing.desc: 进入潜行、消失或 暗影之舞 后 8 秒内，移动速度提高 20%，所受伤害降低 10%。

night-terrors.name: Night Terrors
night-terrors.en: Shuriken Storm reduces enemies' movement speed by 50% for 8 sec.
night-terrors.desc: 袖剑风暴 使敌人的移动速度降低 50%，持续 8 秒。

master-of-shadows.name: Master of Shadows
master-of-shadows.en: Gain 30 Energy over 3 sec when you enter Stealth or activate Shadow Dance.
master-of-shadows.desc: 进入潜行或激活 暗影之舞 时，在 3 秒内回复 30 能量。

gloomblade.name: Gloomblade
gloomblade.en: Punctures your target with your shadow-infused blade for 3,433 Shadow damage, bypassing armor. Critical strikes apply Find Weakness for 10 sec. Awards 1 combo point.
gloomblade.desc: 用注入暗影之力的刀刃刺穿目标，造成 3,433 点暗影伤害，无视护甲。暴击时为目标施加 洞悉弱点，持续 10 秒。给予 1 个连击点。

shadow-focus.name: Shadow Focus
shadow-focus.en: Abilities deal 10% more damage while Stealth or Shadow Dance is active.
shadow-focus.desc: 潜行或 暗影之舞 激活期间，技能造成的伤害提高 10%。

improved-secret-technique.name: Improved Secret Technique
improved-secret-technique.desc: 影分身 造成的伤害提高 15%。

relentless-strikes.name: Relentless Strikes
relentless-strikes.en: Your finishing moves generate 4 Energy per combo point spent.
relentless-strikes.desc: 你的终结技每消耗 1 个连击点回复 4 能量。

weaponmaster.name: Weaponmaster
weaponmaster.en: Gloomblade and Shadowstrike have a 20% chance to create a Shadow Clone that repeats the attack for 50% of normal damage as Shadow.
weaponmaster.desc: 幽暗之刃 与 暗影打击 有 20% 几率召唤一个 Shadow Clone 重复该攻击，造成正常伤害 50% 的暗影伤害。

warning-signs.name: Warning Signs
warning-signs.en: Shadow Dance increases attack speed by 25%.
warning-signs.desc: 暗影之舞 使攻击速度提高 25%。

double-dance.name: Double Dance
double-dance.desc: 暗影之舞 额外拥有 1 次充能。

shadowed-finishers.name: Shadowed Finishers
shadowed-finishers.en: Eviscerate and Black Powder deal an additional 30% damage as Shadow while Find Weakness is active.
shadowed-finishers.desc: 在 洞悉弱点 激活期间，刺骨 与 黑火药 额外造成 30% 暗影伤害。

secret-stratagem.name: Secret Stratagem
secret-stratagem.en: Gain 1 additional max combo point. Your finishing moves that consume more than 5 combo points have increased effects, and your finishing moves deal 5% increased damage.
secret-stratagem.desc: 获得 1 点额外最大连击点上限。消耗超过 5 个连击点的终结技效果提升，且你的终结技伤害提高 5%。

shuriken-tornado.name: Shuriken Tornado
shuriken-tornado.en: Shuriken Storm has a 15% chance to create a Shadow Clone that repeats the attack for 50% of normal damage as Shadow.
shuriken-tornado.desc: 袖剑风暴 有 15% 几率召唤一个 Shadow Clone，以暗影伤害类型造成 50% 正常伤害并重复该攻击。

umbral-edge.name: Umbral Edge
umbral-edge.en: Shadow Clones deal 15% increased damage. Cheap Shot creates a Shadow Clone to Shadowstrike the target for 50% of normal damage as Shadow. Kidney Shot creates a Shadow Clone to Eviscerate the target for 50% of normal damage as Shadow.
umbral-edge.desc: Shadow Clones 造成的伤害提高 15%。偷袭会召唤一个 Shadow Clone 对目标使用 暗影打击，以暗影伤害类型造成 50% 正常伤害。肾击会召唤一个 Shadow Clone 对目标使用 刺骨，以暗影伤害类型造成 50% 正常伤害。

deepening-shadows.name: Deepening Shadows
deepening-shadows.en: Remaining out of combat for 6 sec increases the duration of your next Shadow Dance by 3 sec.
deepening-shadows.desc: 脱战状态持续 6 秒后，下一次 暗影之舞 的持续时间延长 3 秒。

goremaw's-bite.name: Goremaw's Bite
goremaw's-bite.en: Lash out at your target and 2 additional nearby enemies, inflicting 23,959 Shadow damage and causing them to Bleed for 36,539 damage over 14 sec. 20% of all damage from Finishing Moves is repeated as Shadow, split evenly among affected enemies.
goremaw's-bite.desc: 猛扑目标及其附近 2 名敌人，造成 23,959 点暗影伤害，并使其在 14 秒内流血 36,539 点。终结技造成的全部伤害中有 20% 会以暗影伤害类型重复一次，在受影响的敌人之间平均分配。

veiltouched.name: Veiltouched
veiltouched.en: Your abilities deal 5% increased magic damage.
veiltouched.desc: 你的技能造成的魔法伤害提高 5%。

replicating-shadows.name: Replicating Shadows
replicating-shadows.en: Shadow Clones deal 15% increased damage and your effects that have a chance to create them have 5% additional chance to occur.
replicating-shadows.desc: Shadow Clones 造成的伤害提高 15%，且有几率召唤 Shadow Clone 的效果额外增加 5% 的触发概率。

improved-find-weakness.name: Improved Find Weakness
improved-find-weakness.en: Find Weakness causes your attacks to ignore an additional 20% armor.
improved-find-weakness.desc: 洞悉弱点 使你的攻击额外无视 20% 护甲。

perforated-veins.name: Perforated Veins
perforated-veins.en: Backstab, Shuriken Storm, and Shadowstrike have 10% increased damage while Find Weakness is active.
perforated-veins.desc: 在 洞悉弱点 激活期间，背刺、袖剑风暴 与 暗影打击 的伤害提高 10%。

lingering-shadow.name: Lingering Shadow
lingering-shadow.en: After Shadow Dance ends, Backstab deals an additional 50% damage as Shadow, fading by 2.8% per sec.
lingering-shadow.desc: 暗影之舞 结束后，背刺 额外造成 50% 暗影伤害，该效果每秒衰减 2.8%。

potent-powder.name: Potent Powder
potent-powder.en: Black Powder deals increased damage equal to 20% of your Mastery when it spends 5 or more combo points.
potent-powder.desc: 消耗 5 个或更多连击点时，黑火药 伤害额外提升，提升量等于你精通属性的 20%。

death-perception.name: Death Perception
death-perception.en: Find Weakness increases the damage of finishing moves by 10%. Shadow Dance increases the damage of finishing moves by 10%. Shadow Blades increases the damage of finishing moves by 10%.
death-perception.desc: 洞悉弱点 使终结技伤害提高 10%。暗影之舞 使终结技伤害提高 10%。暗影之刃 使终结技伤害提高 10%。

dark-shadow.name: Dark Shadow
dark-shadow.en: Shadow Dance increases all ability damage by 10%, and Shadowstrike and Shuriken Storm damage by an additional 10%.
dark-shadow.desc: 暗影之舞 使所有技能伤害提高 10%，暗影打击 与 袖剑风暴 的伤害额外再提高 10%。

finality.name: Finality
finality.en: Eviscerate and Black Powder have 30% increased critical strike damage bonus.
finality.desc: 刺骨 与 黑火药 的暴击伤害加成提高 30%。

the-rotten.name: The Rotten
the-rotten.en: After activating Shadow Dance, your next 2 attacks that generate combo points deal 35% increased damage.
the-rotten.desc: 激活 暗影之舞 后，接下来 2 次产生连击点的攻击伤害提高 35%。

shadowcraft.name: Shadowcraft
shadowcraft.en: While Shadow Dance is active, your Shadow Techniques triggers 25% more frequently and generates 1 additional combo point.
shadowcraft.desc: 暗影之舞 激活期间，你的 Shadow Techniques 触发频率提高 25%，并额外产生 1 个连击点。

danse-macabre.name: Danse Macabre
danse-macabre.en: While Shadow Dance is active, each different attack that generates or spends combo points lashes out at the target, dealing 13,801 Shadow damage.
danse-macabre.desc: 暗影之舞 激活期间，每种产生或消耗连击点的不同攻击都会额外猛击目标，造成 13,801 点暗影伤害。

the-first-dance.name: The First Dance
the-first-dance.en: Remaining out of combat for 6 sec increases the duration of your next Shadow Dance by 4 sec.
the-first-dance.desc: 脱战状态持续 6 秒后，下一次 暗影之舞 的持续时间延长 4 秒。

dark-brew.name: Dark Brew
dark-brew.en: Your weapon poisons have 10% increased application chance and now deal damage as Shadow instead of Nature. Shadow damage increased by 10%.
dark-brew.desc: 你的武器毒药涂毒几率提高 10%，伤害类型由自然转为暗影。暗影伤害提高 10%。

ancient-arts.name: Ancient Arts
ancient-arts.en: Rank 1: Damaging attacks that expend Shadow Techniques to generate combo points have a 15% chance per stack expended to create a Shadow Clone that repeats the attack for 50% of normal damage as Shadow. Rank 3: Shadow damage increased by 20%. Shadow Clones have a 200% chance to trigger Shadow Techniques' effect. Rank 4: After attacks that generate combo points, if 5 or more stacks of Shadow Techniques remain, your next damaging finishing move will expend them to generate combo points up to your max.
ancient-arts.desc: 第 1 级：消耗 Shadow Techniques 层数产生连击点的伤害性攻击，每消耗 1 层有 15% 几率召唤一个 Shadow Clone，以暗影伤害类型造成 50% 正常伤害并重复该攻击。第 3 级：暗影伤害提高 20%。Shadow Clone 触发 Shadow Techniques 效果的几率为 200%。第 4 级：产生连击点的攻击后，若 Shadow Techniques 剩余 5 层或以上，你的下一次造成伤害的终结技将消耗这些层数，生成连击点至上限。

unseen-blade.name: Unseen Blade
unseen-blade.en: Backstab and Shadowstrike now also strike with an Unseen Blade dealing 9,180 damage. Targets struck are Fazed for 10 sec. Fazed enemies take 8% more damage from you and cannot parry your attacks. This effect may occur once every 15 sec.
unseen-blade.desc: 背刺 与 暗影打击 现在还会以 Unseen Blade 额外攻击，造成 9,180 点伤害。被击中的目标将陷入 Fazed 状态持续 10 秒。Fazed 状态的敌人受到你 8% 更多伤害，且无法招架。

surprising-strikes.name: Surprising Strikes
surprising-strikes.en: Attacks that generate combo points deal 50% increased critical strike damage to Fazed targets.
surprising-strikes.desc: 产生连击点的攻击对 Fazed 目标造成的暴击伤害提高 50%。

smoke.name: Smoke
smoke.en: You take 5% reduced damage from Fazed targets.
smoke.desc: 你受到 Fazed 目标造成的伤害降低 5%。

flawless-form.name: Flawless Form
flawless-form.en: Unseen Blade and Secret Technique increase the damage of your finishing moves by 2% for 12 sec. Max 5 stacks.
flawless-form.desc: Unseen Blade 与 影分身 使你的终结技伤害提高 2%，持续 12 秒。最多叠加 5 层。

hoodwink.name: Hoodwink
hoodwink.en: Fazed increases damage taken by an additional 3%.
hoodwink.desc: Fazed 状态额外使目标受到的伤害提高 3%。

don't-be-suspicious.name: Don't Be Suspicious
don't-be-suspicious.en: Blind and Shroud of Concealment have 10% reduced cooldown. Pick Pocket and Sap have 10 yd increased range.
don't-be-suspicious.desc: 致盲与 潜伏帷幕 的冷却时间缩短 10%。搜索 与闷棍的范围增加 10 码。

devious-distractions.name: Devious Distractions
devious-distractions.en: Secret Technique applies Fazed to any targets struck.
devious-distractions.desc: 影分身 对所有命中的目标施加 Fazed 状态。

thousand-cuts.name: Thousand Cuts
thousand-cuts.en: Slice and Dice grants 10% additional attack speed and gives your auto-attacks a chance to refresh your opportunity to strike with Unseen Blade.
thousand-cuts.desc: 切割 额外提供 10% 攻击速度，并使你的自动攻击有几率重置 Unseen Blade 的攻击机会。

flashing-steel.name: Flashing Steel
flashing-steel.en: Unseen Blade may now occur once every 15 sec and has 25% chance to strike twice.
flashing-steel.desc: Unseen Blade 现在每 15 秒可触发一次，并有 25% 几率连击两次。

disorienting-strikes.name: Disorienting Strikes
disorienting-strikes.en: Secret Technique has 10% reduced cooldown and allows your next 2 strikes of Unseen Blade to ignore its cooldown.
disorienting-strikes.desc: 影分身 冷却缩短 10%，并使你接下来 2 次 Unseen Blade 攻击无视冷却。

cloud-cover.name: Cloud Cover
cloud-cover.en: Activating Shadow Blades creates a cloud of smoke for 6 sec, allowing attacks from within the cloud to apply Fazed, stacking up to 2 additional times. Effect persists for 6 sec after leaving the cloud.
cloud-cover.desc: 激活 暗影之刃 时在周围生成一片烟雾云，持续 6 秒，在云内发动的攻击可叠加 Fazed，最多额外叠加 2 层。离开烟雾云后效果仍持续 6 秒。

nimble-flurry.name: Nimble Flurry
nimble-flurry.en: Your auto-attacks, Unseen Blade, and Coup de Grace also strike up to 7 nearby enemies for 50% of normal damage while Flawless Form is active.
nimble-flurry.desc: Flawless Form 激活期间，你的自动攻击、Unseen Blade 和 Coup de Grace 还会以 50% 的正常伤害额外攻击周围最多 7 个敌人。

clever-combatant.name: Clever Combatant
clever-combatant.en: Shuriken Storm has 10% increased critical strike chance and now triggers Unseen Blade when available.
clever-combatant.desc: 袖剑风暴 暴击率提高 10%，且在 Unseen Blade 可用时触发它。

coup-de-grace.name: Coup de Grace
coup-de-grace.en: After 4 strikes with Unseen Blade, your next Eviscerate will be performed as a Coup de Grace, functioning as if it had consumed 5 additional combo points, and granting you 5 stacks of Flawless Form.
coup-de-grace.desc: 使用 Unseen Blade 攻击 4 次后，你的下一次 刺骨 将以 Coup de Grace 方式施放，效果相当于额外消耗了 5 个连击点，并为你赋予 5 层 Flawless Form。

deathstalker's-mark.name: Deathstalker's Mark
deathstalker's-mark.en: Shadowstrike applies 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to your target, unless Deathstalker's Mark is already active. You learn Mark for Death. When you spend 5 or more combo points on attacks against a Marked target you consume an application of Deathstalker's Mark, dealing 9,074 Plague damage. Mark for Death Move your active Deathstalker's Mark to your target.
deathstalker's-mark.desc: 暗影打击 为目标叠加 3 层 Deathstalker's Mark（若 Deathstalker's Mark 已激活则不叠加）。你习得 Mark for Death。对已标记目标花费 5 个或更多连击点时，消耗一层 Deathstalker's Mark，造成 9,074 点 Plague 伤害。Mark for Death：将你当前激活的 Deathstalker's Mark 转移到目标身上。

clear-the-witnesses.name: Clear the Witnesses
clear-the-witnesses.desc: 袖剑风暴 伤害提高 60%。

hunt-them-down.name: Hunt Them Down
hunt-them-down.en: Auto-attacks against Marked targets deal an additional 630 Plague damage.
hunt-them-down.desc: 对已标记目标的自动攻击额外造成 630 点 Plague 伤害。

singular-focus.name: Singular Focus
singular-focus.en: Damage dealt to targets other than your Marked target deals 5% Plague damage to your Marked target.
singular-focus.desc: 对已标记目标以外的敌人造成的伤害，会对你的已标记目标造成 5% 的 Plague 伤害。

precise-killer.name: Precise Killer
precise-killer.en: Critical strike damage bonus increased by 20%.

unshakeable-drive.name: Unshakeable Drive
unshakeable-drive.en: When you consume an application of Deathstalker's Mark, the damage of your next Gloomblade is increased by 50% or Shadowstrike increased by 25%.
unshakeable-drive.desc: 每次消耗一层 Deathstalker's Mark，你的下一次 破胆之刃 伤害提高 50%，或 暗影打击 伤害提高 25%。

lingering-darkness.name: Lingering Darkness
lingering-darkness.en: After Shadow Blades expires, gain 30% increased Shadow damage for 30 sec.
lingering-darkness.desc: 暗影之刃 结束后，暗影伤害提高 30%，持续 30 秒。

quietus-celeris.name: Quietus Celeris
quietus-celeris.en: Deathstalker's Mark has a 30% chance to immediately consume a stack when applied.
quietus-celeris.desc: Deathstalker's Mark 叠加时有 30% 几率立即消耗一层。

ethereal-cloak.name: Ethereal Cloak
ethereal-cloak.en: Cloak of Shadows duration increased by 2 sec.
ethereal-cloak.desc: 暗影斗篷持续时间延长 2 秒。

momentum-of-despair.name: Momentum of Despair
momentum-of-despair.en: If you have critically struck with Shuriken Storm, increase the critical strike chance of Shuriken Storm and Black Powder by 10% and critical strike damage by 30% for 8 sec.
momentum-of-despair.desc: 若 袖剑风暴 触发暴击，则 袖剑风暴 和 黑火药 的暴击率提高 10%、暴击伤害提高 30%，持续 8 秒。

shadewalker.name: Shadewalker
shadewalker.en: Each time you consume a stack of Deathstalker's Mark, reduce the cooldown of Shadowstep by 3 sec.
shadewalker.desc: 每次消耗一层 Deathstalker's Mark，暗影步 的冷却缩短 3 秒。

mass-casualty.name: Mass Casualty
mass-casualty.en: Deathstalker's Mark deals 75% of its normal damage to all other enemies within 8 yds when a stack is consumed by Black Powder.
mass-casualty.desc: 黑火药 消耗 Deathstalker's Mark 层数时，对 8 码内所有其他敌人造成 75% 的正常伤害。

darkest-night.name: Darkest Night
darkest-night.en: When you consume the final Deathstalker's Mark from a target or your target dies, gain 30 Energy and Darkest Night, causing your next Eviscerate cast with 5 or more combo points to critically strike, deal 50% additional damage, and apply 3 stacks of Deathstalker's Mark to the target if no other Deathstalker's Mark is active. Eviscerate cast with Darkest Night does not consume a stack of active Deathstalker's Marks.
darkest-night.desc: 消耗目标最后一层 Deathstalker's Mark 或目标死亡时，获得 30 点能量和 Darkest Night，使你下一次以 5 个或更多连击点施放的 刺骨 必定暴击、额外造成 50% 伤害，并在没有其他 Deathstalker's Mark 激活的情况下为目标叠加 3 层 Deathstalker's Mark。携带 Darkest Night 施放的 刺骨 不消耗已激活的 Deathstalker's Mark 层数。

thief's-bargain.name: Thief's Bargain
thief's-bargain.en: The cooldowns of Shadow Blades, Vanish, and Feint are reduced by 20%, but using one reduces your damage by 10% for 6 sec.
thief's-bargain.desc: 暗影之刃、消失和佯攻的冷却缩短 20%，但使用其中任意一个后，你的伤害降低 10%，持续 6 秒。

dagger-in-the-dark.name: Dagger in the Dark
dagger-in-the-dark.en: Each second while Stealth is active, nearby enemies within 12 yards take an additional 2% damage from you for 10 sec. Stacks up to 6 times.
dagger-in-the-dark.desc: 潜行期间每过 1 秒，12 码内附近的敌人受到你额外 2% 的伤害，持续 10 秒。最多叠加 6 层。

silhouette.name: Silhouette
silhouette.en: Shadowstep's cooldown is reduced by 67% when cast on a friendly target.
silhouette.desc: 对友方目标施放 暗影步 时，其冷却缩短 67%。

smoke-bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke-bomb.en: Creates a cloud of thick smoke in an 8 yard radius around the Rogue for 5 sec. Enemies are unable to target into or out of the smoke cloud.
smoke-bomb.desc: 在盗贼周围 8 码范围内生成一片浓烟，持续 5 秒。敌人无法对烟雾云内外互相指定目标。

maneuverability.name: Maneuverability
maneuverability.en: Sprint has 50% reduced cooldown and 50% reduced duration.
maneuverability.desc: 疾跑冷却缩短 50%，持续时间缩短 50%。

death-from-above.name: Death from Above
death-from-above.en: Finishing move that empowers your weapons with energy to perform a deadly attack. You leap into the air and Eviscerate your target on the way back down, with such force that it has a 15% stronger effect.
death-from-above.desc: 终结技，以能量强化武器发动致命一击。你腾跃而起，在落下时对目标施放 刺骨，威力强劲，效果提高 15%。

dismantle.name: Dismantle
dismantle.en: Disarm the enemy, preventing the use of any weapons or shield for 5 sec.
dismantle.desc: 卸除敌人武装，使其 5 秒内无法使用任何武器或盾牌。

thick-as-thieves.name: Thick as Thieves
thick-as-thieves.en: Tricks of the Trade now increases the friendly target's damage by 15% for 6 sec.
thick-as-thieves.desc: 偷天换日现在使友方目标的伤害提高 15%，持续 6 秒。

distracting-mirage.name: Distracting Mirage
distracting-mirage.en: Distract slows affected enemies by 60% and creates a Mirage that follows an enemy for 8 sec. Reactivate Distract to teleport to your Mirage's location.
distracting-mirage.desc: 扰乱使受影响的敌人减速 60%，并生成一个跟随敌人的 Mirage，持续 8 秒。再次激活扰乱可传送至 Mirage 的位置。

control-is-king.name: Control is King
control-is-king.en: Cheap Shot grants Slice and Dice for 15 sec and Kidney Shot restores 10 Energy per combo point spent.
control-is-king.desc: 偷袭为你赋予 切割 效果，持续 15 秒；肾击每消耗 1 个连击点恢复 10 点能量。

preemptive-maneuver.name: Preemptive Maneuver
preemptive-maneuver.en: Feint decreases your damage taken by an additional 40% while stunned and its energy cost is reduced by 30%.
preemptive-maneuver.desc: 佯攻在你处于昏迷状态时额外降低你受到的伤害 40%，且能量消耗降低 30%。
